scope: Complete saved baseline onboard census; no sample or counterfactual actual outcome.
selection: All 72 roots and every combined_rolling onboard receipt. Eligibility uses only current retained platform plus at least one later retained exit on that ride, not score gaps or losses.
feasibility: Two actions means two structural menu choices; it does not assert either continuation succeeds in the realized world or under every conditional draw.
history_restoration: SingleMessageHistory with unchanged V35 fitted emission; restore saved own/local facts, raw forecasts and notices, clear laws, and attach no future frame stream.
